title: Bessent blames Lutnick’s Commerce as he slams Nvidia chip ‘leakage’ to China
summary_full: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO days after admitting to an affair following scrutiny of his relationship with a woman reportedly deemed a Chinese spy.
